scene: The glowing droplet chimes in your palm, illuminating three waiting transit platforms.
picture: A flat side view along the polished platform. On the far left, a glass-roofed trolley rests on brass rails. Left of centre, the woman in lilac headscarf and mustard coat holds a glowing cyan droplet. In the centre, an open spiral lift stands waiting. On the far right, a red cable tram sits docked.
shown: a glass-roofed trolley waiting on tracks with doors open, on the far left
a wrought-iron spiral lift with a welcoming operator, standing in the centre
a red mountain cable tram moored to a wooden dock, on the far right
